nameOrigin: piece of metal for opening locks

pokedexEntries.x: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

pokedexEntries.or: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

pokedexEntries.y: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

pokedexEntries.as: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

pokedexEntries.su: This even-tempered Pokémon has a habit of collecting keys. It will sneak into people’s homes to steal their keys.

pokedexEntries.mo: It inserts its horn into chinks in metal, absorbing metal ions. For some reason, it collects keys.

pokedexEntries.us: Although it’s unclear why it collects keys, giving it a key makes Klefki very happy. However, it apparently only likes master keys.

pokedexEntries.um: Long ago it lived in mines, but once the minerals that make up its diet became scarcer, Klefki began appearing in human settlements.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon is constantly collecting keys. Entrust a Klefki with important keys, and the Pokémon will protect them no matter what.

pokedexEntries.sh: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.

pokedexEntries.sc: Once it absorbs a key’s metal ions, it discards the key without a second thought. However, it will hang on to keys it favors for decades.

pokedexEntries.vi: In the past, noble families entrusted their vault keys to a Klefki. They passed the Klefki down through the generations, taking good care of it.

pokedexEntries.za: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.
